# Same-Day Ticket

We recommend making advance [web ticket](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html) reservations for the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route. If [web tickets](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html) are sold out, please purchase tickets on the day.


## Please select the station from which you wish to depart.![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/icn-tip.svg)

- [Dentetsu Toyama](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Toyama)
- [Tateyama Station](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Tateyama)
- [Ogizawa](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Ogizawa)

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/img-map@2x.png?date=260128)

## Dentetsu Toyama (Toyama side)

### Main Routes Available for Purchase

| Route | Fare | Required time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dentetsu Toyama → Ogizawa (one way) | 12,360JPY | 7-8hrs |
| Dentetsu Toyama ⇔ Kurobeko (round trip) | 19,320JPY | 10-11hrs |
| Dentetsu Toyama ⇔ Murodo (round trip) | 10,220JPY | 7-8hrs |

\*Tickets for other routes can also be purchased. Please enquire at the ticket counter for details.

### Payment Options

Cash or credit cards

![JCB, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club International, UnionPay, Discover](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/img-credit@2x.png)

### Hours

7:30 to 11:00 (May open at 5:00 depending on the day. Closed after the winter schedule.

### 【Ticket office site】

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/pt-office-toyama@2x.jpg)

[\*Important points when purchasing (please read)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Notice)

## Tateyama Station (Toyama side)

### Main Routes Available for Purchase

| Route | Fare | Required time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tateyama Station → Ogizawa (one way) | 10,940JPY | 6-7hrs |
| Tateyama Station ⇔ Kurobeko (round trip) | 16,480JPY | 8-9hrs |
| Tateyama Station ⇔ Murodo (round trip) | 7,380JPY | 5-6hrs |

\*Tickets for other routes can also be purchased. Please enquire at the ticket counter for details.

### Payment Options

Cash or credit cards

![JCB, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club International, UnionPay, Discover](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/img-credit@2x.png)

### Hours

Opens 20 min before the first service.

### 【Ticket office site】

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/pt-office-tateyama@2x.jpg)

[\*Important points when purchasing (please read)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Notice)

## Ogizawa (Nagano side)

### Main Routes Available for Purchase

| Route | Fare | Required time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ogizawa → Tateyama Station (one way) | 10,940JPY | 6-7hrs |
| Ogizawa → Dentetsu Toyama (one way) | 12,360JPY | 7-8hrs |
| Ogizawa ⇔ Murodo (round trip) | 12,300JPY | 6-7hrs |

\*Tickets for other routes can also be purchased. Please enquire at the ticket counter for details.

### Payment Options

Cash or credit cards

![JCB, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club International, UnionPay, Discover](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/img-credit@2x.png)

### Hours

Opens 40 min before the first service.

### 【Ticket office site】

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/same-day-tickets/pt-office-ogizawa@2x.jpg)

[\*Important points when purchasing (please read)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/same-day-tickets/#Notice)

[2026.09.04\\ \\ 【WEB Tickets】Sale of Murodo Direct Bus Tickets (September and October)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/direct-bus) - [2026.09.01\\ \[WEB Tickets\] Sales schedule for WEB tickets in 2026](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/sales-schedule) - [2026.09.01\\ \[WEB Tickets\] Extension of Autumn Early Bird Discount Web Ticket Sales (Until November 10th)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/early-bird-2) - [2026.08.31\\ \\ ■Press Release for August: Information on WEB Tickets Recommended for Fall Travel](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/61c98ac039bcdcd924f5a1c625f12d4a.pdf) ## What is the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route? This world-class mountain sightseeing route traverses the Northern Japan Alps, where peaks soaring over 3,000 meters rise in succession. Spanning 37.2 km with a maximum elevation difference of 1,975 meters, nearly the entire route is located within Chubu Sangaku National Park. Experience the journey by a variety of transportation modes and enjoy the breathtaking alpine scenery. ## How to Enjoy the Alpine Route ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/home/pt-enjoy01@2x.jpg) ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/home/pt-enjoy02@2x.jpg) ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/home/pt-enjoy03@2x.jpg) ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/home/pt-enjoy04@2x.jpg) ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/assets_v2/img/home/pt-enjoy05@2x.jpg) [See Details](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/how-to-enjoy/)

metadata.title: TATEYAMAKUROBE ALPINE ROUTE
metadata.description: The Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route is one of the world’s most spectacular high-altitude mountain sightseeing routes, traversing the 3,000-meter-class peaks of the Northern Alps between Toyama and Nagano.By transferring between a variety of unique modes of transportation, visitors can easily enjoy breathtaking scenery shaped by the grandeur of nature.

# 【WEB Ticket Pre Sale】Book Early, Good to Go!

2026.02.18

Thank you for traveling with us!

(PRE SALE) WEB Tickets for one-way trips【Dentetsu Toyama – Ogizawa / Ogizawa – Dentetsu Toyama】will be available from 10am on March 2 onwards.

Check the details as below and get ready for 2026 season!

**【Pre Sale】WEB Ticket Reservation Details　\*LIMITED NUMBER**

**1\. Traveling Sections**

Only these 2 sections listed as below are available for the Pre Sale item.

\*Round-trip tickets are not available.

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/e9e0135102d298986648a08fe088fdd7.png)

You can purchase option tickets for express bus (Ogizawa – Nagano) and local bus (Ogizawa – Shinano Omachi).

Please add on this option ticket upon purchase.

The last express bus from Ogizawa Station to Nagano Station departs Ogizawa Station at 17:00. Passengers traveling to Nagano should pay attention to the conection time.

▼Planning a round-trip or different traveling sections?

WEB Tickets for all sections will be on sale from March 13 onwards.

Please check the sales details here [【Standard WEB Ticket Sale】Mark Your Calendar and Let’s Go!](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/spring2026)

**2\. Sales Schedule**

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/1eb4412d2d654dba8fb985d27c44d0ef.png)

**3\. Fare**

Normal fare will be applied to this pre-sale item as well as option tickets.

[Fare for individual customers (1-14 people)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/transport/fare.html)

If you wish to take an express train between Dentetsu Toyama and Tateyama, you will need to pay an additional express fare.

Express fare have changed from April 1st, please visit [“Regarding the Operation of Rapid limited express trains and Revisions to Limited Express Fares”](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/train-express-fares)

**4\. How to Purchase**

This ticket can be purchased only on [WEB Ticket Page](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html).

\*Cannot be purchased at a ticket counter.

**5\. 【IMPORTANT】 Cancellation Policy**

**If you cancel after 11:59pm, 10 days before your departure date, cancellation fee of 1,000JPY per person will be applied.**

<E.g.> If you purchased a pre-sale ticket for April 15

(1) **No cancellation fee** applied if you canceled by 11:59pm on April 5.

(2) **1,000JPY** applied if you canceled after 11:59pm on April 5.

**6\. Others**

\*WEB Tickets (Dentetsu Toyama-Tateyama Station-Ogizawa) are valid for 5 days.

**\*This is a pre-sale item, so we cannot accept customer request for changing traveling sections at a ticket counter.**

**\*Please refrain from making reservations through travel agencies.**

Have an easy, convenient trip with WEB Tickets!

We look forward to your booking! [WEB Ticket page](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html)

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/pic.png)

[← Back to list](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/announcement/)

# 【Standard WEB Ticket Sale】Mark Your Calendar and Let’s Go!

2026.03.13

Thank you for traveling with us!

Standard WEB Ticket for April and May will be on sale from 3pm on March 13 onwards.

Please see the sales details as below.

**Standard WEB Ticket Details**

**１．Sales Schedule**

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/3e3bd53c01148d1be6ae465d42720ca4.png)

\*Sales schedule for June onwards will be announced when we have details, so stay tuned! Tickets will be on sale usually one month before.

\*The sales schedule is current as of March 13, 2026.

\*Please note that it may be subject to change.

\*We will inform you of the schedule from November 4th onwards at a later date.

**2\. Traveling Sections**

[WEB Ticket Reservation Traveling Sections](https://www.alpen-route.com/_wp/yoyakuweb_kukan)

**3\. Fare**

Normal fare will be applied to this WEB Ticket and option ticket.

[Fares for individual customers (1-14 people)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/transport/fare.html)

If you wish to take an express train between Dentetsu Toyama and Tateyama, you will need to pay an additional express fare.

Express fare have changed from April 1st, please visit [“Regarding the Operation of Rapid limited express trains and Revisions to Limited Express Fares”](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/train-express-fares)

**4\. How to Purchase**

This ticket can be purchased only on [WEB Ticket Page](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html).

\*Cannot be purchased at a ticket counter.

**5\. Others**

[<WEB Ticket> How to Change or Cancel Your Reservation](https://www.alpen-route.com/_wp/webticket_change_and_cancellation)

\*Sales period for June onwards will be anounced when we have details.

**\*Please refrain from making reservations through travel agencies.**

Have an easy, convenient trip with WEB Tickets!

We look forward to your booking! [WEB Ticket Page](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html)

# Autumn Early Bird Discount WEB ticket

2026.05.25

Thank you for traveling with us!

Following the “Summer Early Bird Web Ticket,” we will be selling the “Autumn Early Bird Web Ticket,” which can be used from September 1st to November 3rd.

It is 10 days advance early bird discount web ticket.

Please enjoy the Alpine Route in June and July with this great value ticket!

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/4e1040f99c56d9b1617b7110816e399d.jpg)

Tateyama Ropeway with Autumn leaves【Early Oct – Mid Oct】

**Details for ”Autumn Early Bird Discount WEB ticket”**

1. What is ”Early Bird Discount WEB ticket for Autumn season.”?

You can purchase tickets (designated sections) at a special price  up to 10 days in advance.

Don’t miss out on this great opportunity!

2\. Sales Period and Departure Dates

Sales Period: 10 am on July 1 to 11:59 pm on October 24

Departure Dates: September 1 to November 3

<Caution>

Booking can be made by 11:59 pm, 10 days prior to your departure date.

Please note that the purchase, change, and cancellation deadlines are different from the 55th Anniversary Early Bird tickets from June 1st to July 25th.

![](http://www.alpen-route.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/375826989b1b05fd36d7b4f2dc81d4f8.png)

We will continue selling the Summer Early Bird Web Ticket. Click here for details on the Summer Early Bird Web Ticket.

[Summer Early Bird Web Ticket](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/summer-early-bird).

3\. Traveling Sections and Fare

Only sections listed below will be on sale for this item.

**From Ogizawa**

① <Ogizawa to Tateyama Station (one way)>

Adult: ~~10,940JPY~~ 9,900JPY

Child:   ~~5,480JPY~~ 4,950JPY

② <Ogizawa to Dentetsu Toyama (one way)>

Adult: ~~12,360JPY~~ 11,250JPY

Child:   ~~6,190JPY~~ 5,630JPY

③ <Ogizawa to Murodo (round trip)>

Adult: ~~12,300JPY~~ 11,300JPY

Child:    ~~6,150JPY~~ 5,650JPY

**From Tateyama Station**

④ <Tateyama Station to Ogizawa (one way)>

Adult: ~~10,940JPY~~ 9,900JPY

Child:   ~~5,480JPY~~ 4,950JPY

⑤ <Dentetsu Toyama to Ogizawa (one way)>

Adult: ~~12,360JPY~~ 11,250JPY

Child:   ~~6,190JPY~~ 5,630JPY

⑥ <Tateyama Station to Kurobeko (round trip)>

Adult: ~~16,480JPY~~ 14,900JPY

Child:   ~~8,240JPY~~ 7,450JPY

⑦ <Dentetsu Toyama to Kurobeko (round trip)>

Adult: ~~19,320JPY~~ 17,600JPY

Child:    ~~9,660JPY~~ 8,800JPY

For sections from ① to ⑤,

You can purchase option tickets for express bus (Ogizawa to Nagano) and local bus (Ogizawa to Shinano Omachi).

Please purchase this option ticket with a Summer Early Bird Discount WEB ticket.

The last express bus from Ogizawa Station to Nagano Station departs Ogizawa Station at 17:00. Passengers traveling to Nagano should pay attention to the connection time.

Even the first express bus departing from Nagano Station arrives at Ogizawa at 9:25.Please pay close attention to the departure time from Ogizawa.

If you wish to take an express train between Dentetsu Toyama and Tateyama, you will need to pay an additional express fare.

Express fare have changed from April 1st, please visit [“Regarding the Operation of Rapid limited express trains and Revisions to Limited Express Fares”](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/train-express-fares)

4\. How to Purchase

This discount ticket can be purchased only on [WEB ticket page](https://tateyama-kurobe-webservice.jp/AlpenTour/html/VW001W0010.html).

\*This cannot be purchased at a ticket counter.

5\. <Important> Cancellation policy

If you cancel after 11:59 pm, 10 days before your departure day, cancellation fee of 1,000JPY will be applied.

<E.g.> If you purchased a ”Early Bird Discount WEB ticket” for September １,

(1) **No cancellation fee** if you canceled by 11:59 pm on Augsut 22.

(2) **1,000JPY** if you canceled after 11:59 pm on August 22.

6\. Others

Both one-way and round-trip tickets (Dentetsu Toyama-Tateyama Station-Ogizawa) are valid for 5 days.

Due to a discount ticket, we cannot accept customer request for changing traveling sections at a ticket counter.

Standard WEB ticket  for normal fare and other sections will be available from the link below.

Please check the sales details here [Standard WEB Ticket Sales of WEB Ticket Reservation (Normal Fare)](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/spring2026)

web.markdown:
# How to Buy a Ticket

## On the Day

### Buying a Ticket

- Please refer to the table below when puchasing tickets on the day of travel.
- Day tickets are only available\_on the day of your visit. There are no advance sales for day tickets.
- **The ticket is valid for 5 days after the purchase date. This is not a ‘free ride’ (unlimited travel) ticket.**
- Tickets can be paid for by cash or credit card.

Stations that accept credit card are marked ![C](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/icn-marked.png) in the table below.

- The JR Japan Rail Pass cannot be used on the Alpine Route. It can be used between Shinano Omachi and Nagano Stations by JR.
- Tickets go on sale at Tateyama Station 20 minutes before the first departure,and Ogizawa 40 minutes before the first departure.
- Depending on the congestion situation, it may take some time to purchase your ticket.
- On busy days, the sale of tickets for certain sections and round trip day tickets may be restricted.

### Riding the Alpine Route

- When riding the Tateyama Cable Car from Tateyama Station or the Kanden Tunnel Electric Bus from Ogizawa, please take the vehicle departing at the time indicated on your ticket. Please note that this designated boarding time only applies on the day the ticket was purchased.
- If you wish to ride the Tateyama Cable Car (from Tateyama Station) at a specific time, please use the web ticket reservation on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route Official Site. Please note that the number of advance ticket reservations is limitied. At other stations, please line up at the vehicle boarding gate.

## Toyama / Tateyama → Ogizawa / Shinano Omachi / Nagano

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket01_2503.png)

### Ticket Office

#### 1.Dentetsu Toyama Station  accept credit card

##### Attention

You can buy tickets for the Dentetsu-Toyama- Ogizawa route at the Dentetsu-Toyama Station. Please purchase at Ogizawa Station for between Ogizawa and Omachi Onsen, Shinano Omachi.

You can reserve a boarding time for the Tateyama cable car departing from Tateyama Station. (Reservations are not accepted from individual customers for vehicles other than the Tateyama Cable Car.)

When using [a baggage forwarding service](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/transport/ticket.html/baggage.html), time is needed to arrange so please arrive to board 20 to 30 minutes early.


##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket02.png)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket01.jpg)

Outside of the above hours, please purchase a ticket to Tateyama Station from the ticket machines, and then purchase your Alpine Route ticket at Tateyama Station.

#### 2.Tateyama Station  accept credit card

##### Attention

Tickets for all stations up to Dentetsu Toyama Station are available here. If you buy tickets here, you no longer need to buy a new ticket for each transportat link along the route.

There is no baggage delivery service here.

##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket03.png)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket02.jpg)Ticket Sales Counter
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket03.jpg)Information Center

#### 3.Ogizawa Station

##### Attention

Please purchase tickets for the Local Bus between Ogizawa and Shinano Omachi Station, or for the Express bus between Ogizawa and Nagano Station here. It is not possible to get a refund if you purchase a full ticket but get off at an earlier stop. Please be sure to buy a ticket only as far as your destination.

##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket04_new.png)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket04b.jpg)Ticket Sales Counter

(For Shinano Omachi,Nagano)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket04c.jpg)

## Ogizawa / Shinano Omachi / Nagano → Toyama / Tateyama

![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket05_2203.png)

### Ticket Office

#### 4.Nagano Station express bus stop

##### Attention

Please purchase tickets on the bus. Have change ready.

##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket06_en_2303.png)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket05.jpg)Boarding platform bus stop number 25

#### 5.Shinano Omachi Station (Bus ticket office is in front of the station)

##### Attention

1) Bus tickets to Ogizawa are available here.

2) [A baggage delivery service](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/transport/ticket.html/baggage.html) is available at in front of JR Shinano Omachi Station.


##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket07_all_2303.jpg)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket06.jpg)Local Bus ticket office
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket07_2303.jpg)Reception desk in front of JR Shinano Omachi Station


（reception counter for baggage delivery service）

#### 6.Ogizawa Station  accept credit card

##### Attention

Tickets for all stations up to Dentetsu Toyama Station are available here. If you buy tickets here, you no longer need to buy a new ticket for each transportat link along the route.

There is no baggage delivery service here.

##### Ticket office site

- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/img-ticket08.png)
- ![](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/media/transport/ticket_1801/pt-ticket08.jpg)

#### 7.Tateyama Station 1F

##### Attention

Please purchase tickets to Toyama Station or Unazuki onsen from the ticket machines on the first floor of Tateyama Station.
